new_kpis.source: ASML FY25 Annual Report US GAAP - Note Segment
new_kpis.comment: FY25 Net System Sales = EUR 24.474 Mds (+12.4% YoY). 535 unites litho recognized (FY24: 583, FY23: 600). Mix premium EUV drive valeur unit. CORE HERO KPI ASML.

new_kpis.source: ASML FY25 AR Note 2 - Disaggregation par techno
new_kpis.comment: FY25 EUV revenue = NXE EUR 10.446 Mds (44 units) + EXE EUR 1.157 Mds (4 units) = EUR 11.603 Mds. +39% YoY. 48 EUV systems shipped vs 44 FY24. Cle thesis AI demand.

new_kpis.source: ASML FY25 Strategic Report - CEO message
new_kpis.comment: Backlog 'currently stands at a healthy level of EUR 38.8 Mds' fin 2025. Remaining Performance Obligations EUR 46.5 Mds (vs 43.3 fin 24), dont 65% reconnu sur 12 prochains mois. PRIME KPI visibilite revenu.

new_kpis.source: ASML FY25 AR Financial Performance KPI
new_kpis.comment: FY25 GM = 52.8% (FY24: 51.3%, +1.5 ppt). Drivers: NXE product mix favorable, hausse service & field options margins. EUR 17.258 Mds gross profit.

FY25 Total Net Sales = EUR 32.667 Mds (+15.6% YoY). Net System Sales EUR 24.474 Mds + Net Service & Field Options EUR 8.193 Mds. Logic EUR 16.054 Mds (49%) + Memory EUR 8.420 Mds (26%) + S&FO EUR 8.193 Mds.
FY25 Income from Operations EUR 11.301 Mds = 34.6% of sales (FY24: 31.9%). +270bps. Levier operationnel sur scale + GM expansion.
FY25 Net Income EUR 9.609 Mds (+26.9% YoY). EPS basic EUR 24.73 (FY24: EUR 19.25). Driver = GM + op margin.
FY25 FCF = EUR 11.0 Mds (FY24: EUR 9.1 Mds). OCF EUR 12.658 Mds - capex EUR 1.574 Mds - intangibles EUR 58M. Finance dividende + buybacks EUR 8.5 Mds returned to shareholders FY25.

notes: HERO STOCKE 'R&D' = SUSPECT confirme. R&D 14.4% est un input cost, pas le KPI hero pour analyste. VRAI hero = Net System Sales (EUR 24.5 Mds, +12.4%) ou EUV System Sales (EUR 11.6 Mds, +39% via 48 EUV vs 44) ou Backlog (EUR 38.8 Mds). FY25 fortement positif: rev +15.6%, GM +1.5ppt, op margin +2.7ppt, NI +27%.
